content: Efonamma ch'Adam
Ma wọ ode nnwẹr kw'odem kw'efonamma ch'Adam. Mada iwa Ibinọkpaabyi oyokhi anọngẹya, wa osi bẹ ka ngera sẹ.
Wa oyokhi bẹ, ojinọng ọmaana kwanọng, odo bẹ, oyeri bẹ, Anọngẹya.
Wa Adam okk'cho arọbh azadani obhiri jobh orukha, yina on-obhoni nnwa kw'ijinọng ka ngera sẹ, ọkpẹ-ẹ Sẹt.
Mada Adam okk'Sẹt obhona, wa obiro oruk cho nnọhna mfa, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Adam orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh azadani obhiri jobh, yina on-ope.
Mada Sẹt okk'cho arọbh azen obhiri azen orukha, obhon Ẹnọs.
Mada Sẹt okk'Ẹnọs obhona, wa obiro oruk cho nnọhna mfa obhiri azenamfa, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Sẹt orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh azen obhiri jobh obhiri afa, yina on-ope.
Mada Ẹnọs okk'cho arọbh anna obhiri jobh orukha, obhon Kenan.
Mada okk'Kenan obhona, wa obiro oruk cho nnọhna mfa obhiri chi, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Ẹnọs orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh azen obhiri azen, yina on-ope.
Mada Kenan okk'cho arọbh attaan obhiri jobh orukha, obhon Mahalalẹl.
Mada okk'Mahalalẹl obhona, wa obiro oruk cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh afa, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Kenan orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh azen obhiri jobh, yina on-ope.
Mada Mahalalẹl okk'cho arọbh attaan obhiri azen orukha, obhon Jarẹd.
Mada Mahalalẹl okk'Jarẹd obhona, wa obiro oruk cho nnọhna mfa obhiri ẹrọbh obhiri jobh, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Mahalalẹl orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh anna obhiri chi, yina on-ope.
Mada Jarẹd okk'cho arọbh azenanttaan obhiri afa orukha, obhon Ẹnọk.
Mada Jarẹd okk'Ẹnọk obhona, obiro oruk cho nnọhna mfa, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Jarẹd orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh azenanttaan obhiri afa, yina on-ope.
Mada Ẹnọk okk'cho arọbh attaan obhiri azen orukha, obhon Mẹtusẹla.
Mada okk'Mẹtusẹla obhona, Ẹnọk ochina ororo ọtzọn Ibinọkpaabyi abẹ ka cho arọbh chi adọdọk, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Ẹnọk orukhi cho arọbh chi obhiri arọbh attaan obhiri azen.
Wa Ẹnọk ochina ororo ọtzọn Ibinọkpaabyi abẹ, mẹ wọ, Ibinọkpaabyi otzim-ẹ ofona m'oyagbin nwa.
Mada Mẹtusẹla okk'cho arọbh ọhawani kwa jobh obhiri azenamfa orukha, obhon Lamẹk.
Mada okk'Lamẹk obhona, wa Mẹtusẹla obiro oruk cho ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh chi obhiri azenanttaan obhiri afa, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Mẹtusẹla orukhi cho nnọhna mfa obhiri arọbh azenattaan obhiri ọhawani kwa jobh, yina on-ope.
Mada Lamẹk okk'cho arọbh ọhawani obhiri afa orukha, obhon nnwa kw'ijinọng,
ọkpẹ-ẹ Noa. Lamẹk on-oben bi, “Nnwa nwa ótzima ẹwọhngkwokha ochena man, k'ọtzọhm faman, ọmaana k'ihem saman, s'ifon k'irerek s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'ẹmma ọnanga.”
Mada Lamẹk okk'Noa obhona, wa obiro oruk cho ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh ọhawani obhiri chi, obiro obhon ajinọng ọmaana panọng adọdọk.
Biphyir-phyir, wa Lamẹk orukhi cho ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh chi obhiri attaan obhiri chi obhiri afa, yina on-ope.
Mada Noa okk'cho ẹnọhna obhiri arọbh azen ọda, obhon va p'ijinọng attaan, p'ade Shẹm, ọmaana Ham, ọmaana Japhẹt.
